response.original_title: Silih Asah, Silih Asih, Silih Rusuh
response.overview: In a dysfunctional family intoxicated by online gambling money, only the youngest son, Tisna, refuses to celebrate his father's newfound wealth. As the family splurges on luxury while neglecting their most basic responsibilities, three creditors : a laundress, a vegetable vendor, and the landlord. Appear as living reminders of the necessities they have abandoned.  Determined to pay off the debts, Tisna desperately tries to seize control of his father's bank account. What follows is an absurd yet violent battle over dirty money, exposing a family willing to sacrifice everything for fleeting comfort, until the conflict ends in a tragedy as ironic as it is inevitable.
response.tagline: "No matter how messed up my family is, they're still my family."
response.title: Silih Asah, Silih Asih, Silih Rusuh
